note: Both sets contain significant errors, particularly confusing wiring symbols 20 and 50 (swapping specifications) and hallucinating wire IDs (A: 11, 104, 107; B: 101, 105). Set B is slightly better because it correctly extracts Wiring Schedule 10 and Note 7 (Junction Box), which Set A misses. Set B also correctly identifies the Main Service Panel conduit size (2-1/2"), whereas Set A misattributes this to Circuit 150. Although Set B incorrectly assigns the 200A breaker to the Sub-Panel (it is 50A), Set A's claim of a '3 W' breaker rating is nonsensical. Set B has fewer hallucinated entities.
